name: waveflow-platform
description: Monorepo dev orchestration for waveflow-server (Rust) + the embedded webapp client.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "bun run typecheck:server" "bun run typecheck:web"
